headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of November 2, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming the SPY benchmark with an average return of 19.99% compared to SPY's 10.99%. This 8.99% average alpha indicates that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a notable return of 37.98%, significantly contributing to the overall outperformance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has seen a slight decline, highlighting the variability within the set. This relative performance is particularly relevant during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience against broader market trends. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
